title: Basic floor area regulations
previewText: Commercial floor area ratio In C4-3 or C4-4 Districts, the maximum floor area ratio for commercial uses shall be 4.0. Community facility floor area ratio In M1 Districts with an A suffix paired with an R7-3 District, the maximum floor area ratio for community facility uses shall be 6.5.
